about: Commander Spellbook combos (commanderspellbook.com). cards, features and templates map Spellbook ids to names. Each combo is [id, result feature ids, popularity, bracket tag, extras]: the id is the combo's card ids joined by -, then --template id for each generic piece it also needs; popularity is roughly how many EDHREC decks hold it; extras can hold q (card id: copies needed), tq (template id: how many) and c (card ids that must be your commander).
